correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 ships a default resource.exclusions in the argocd-cm ConfigMap. Environments whose argocd-cm does not set data["resource.exclusions"] get the new default exclusions (Endpoints, EndpointSlice, Lease, review kinds, CertificateSigningRequest, PolicyReport, CertificateRequest, Kyverno and Cilium kinds). Environments that set the key explicitly keep their own configuration.
